text_a: Ana le envía el informe a Luis antes del viernes.
text_b: Luis recibe de Ana el informe antes del viernes.

text_a: The client must pay the supplier within 30 days.
text_b: The supplier must pay the client within 30 days.
what_differs: payer and payee swapped

text_a: O gerente deve avisar a equipe sobre a mudança de horário.
text_b: A equipe deve avisar o gerente sobre a mudança de horário.
what_differs: who notifies whom is swapped

text_a: Please have Maria review the draft that Tom wrote.
text_b: Please have Tom review the draft that Maria wrote.
what_differs: reviewer and author swapped

text_a: El equipo de soporte resolvió el ticket ayer.
text_b: El ticket fue resuelto ayer por el equipo de soporte.

text_a: The auditors will review all invoices next week.
text_b: All invoices will be reviewed by the auditors next week.

text_a: O fornecedor entregou a encomenda ao cliente.
text_b: A encomenda foi entregue pelo cliente ao fornecedor.
what_differs: passive version swaps agent: client delivers to supplier

text_a: Se recomienda cambiar la contraseña cada tres meses.
text_b: Recomendamos que cambie la contraseña cada tres meses.
what_differs: impersonal recommendation vs. first-person recommendation by the speaker; whether the source of the recommendation matters is debatable

text_a: Back up the database every night.
text_b: Run a database backup nightly.

text_a: El servidor casi nunca se reinicia solo.
text_b: El servidor nunca se reinicia solo.
what_differs: 'casi nunca' allows rare restarts; 'nunca' excludes them

text_a: Normalmente revisamos os logs às segundas-feiras.
text_b: Sempre revisamos os logs às segundas-feiras.
what_differs: 'normalmente' (usually) vs 'sempre' (always)

text_a: Sometimes the deployment fails on Fridays.
text_b: The deployment occasionally fails on Fridays.
what_differs: 'sometimes' and 'occasionally' are close but may imply different frequencies

text_a: Ningún empleado puede entrar sin credencial.
text_b: Todo empleado debe tener credencial para entrar.

text_a: Not all tests passed.
text_b: No tests passed.
what_differs: 'not all' allows some to pass; 'no' means none passed

text_a: Pelo menos um aprovador deve assinar o contrato.
text_b: Todos os aprovadores devem assinar o contrato.
what_differs: at least one vs all

text_a: Algunos clientes no recibieron la factura.
text_b: No todos los clientes recibieron la factura.
what_differs: logically close, but 'algunos no' may imply that others did, while 'no todos' is weaker; readers may disagree

text_a: This laptop is cheaper than that one.
text_b: That laptop is more expensive than this one.

text_a: A versão nova é tão rápida quanto a antiga.
text_b: A versão nova é mais rápida que a antiga.
what_differs: equal speed vs strictly faster

text_a: Marta es la que más vendió este trimestre.
text_b: Nadie vendió más que Marta este trimestre.

text_a: The new plan costs less than the old one.
text_b: The new plan costs not more than the old one.
what_differs: 'less than' is strictly cheaper; 'not more than' allows equal cost

text_a: Cerramos el puerto porque detectamos una intrusión.
text_b: Detectamos una intrusión, así que cerramos el puerto.

text_a: After the server crashed, we restored the backup.
text_b: We restored the backup because the server crashed.
what_differs: temporal sequence vs explicit causation; implicature may make them the same, but not necessarily

text_a: Reiniciamos o sistema depois de instalar a atualização.
text_b: Instalamos a atualização depois de reiniciar o sistema.
what_differs: order of restart and update swapped

text_a: Since the invoice was overdue, the account was suspended.
text_b: The account was suspended because the invoice was overdue.

text_a: Revisa los correos que llegaron después de las 5 p. m.
text_b: Revisa los correos recibidos después de las 5 p. m.

text_a: Notify the employees who work remotely.
text_b: Notify the employees, who work remotely.
what_differs: restrictive (only remote workers) vs non-restrictive (all employees, who happen to be remote)

text_a: Apague os arquivos que estão na pasta temporária.
text_b: Apague os arquivos, que estão na pasta temporária.
what_differs: comma makes clause non-restrictive, so all files are deleted

text_a: Send the report to the manager who approved the budget.
text_b: Send the report to the manager, who approved the budget.
what_differs: with a single manager in context both are the same; otherwise the commas change the referent

text_a: El archivo pesa aproximadamente 200 MB.
text_b: El archivo pesa más o menos 200 MB.

text_a: The meeting lasts exactly one hour.
text_b: The meeting lasts up to one hour.
what_differs: exact duration vs maximum duration

text_a: Precisamos de no máximo 50 voluntários.
text_b: Precisamos de cerca de 50 voluntários.
what_differs: upper limit vs approximate target

text_a: The package should arrive in about a week.
text_b: The package should arrive in roughly seven days.
what_differs: 'a week' and 'seven days' are numerically identical, but idiomatic vagueness may differ

text_a: The deadline is 03/04/2026 in US format.
text_b: The deadline is March 4, 2026.

text_a: La entrega es el 05/06/2026.
text_b: La entrega es el 6 de mayo de 2026.
what_differs: in dd/mm, 05/06 is 5 June, not 6 May

text_a: Primeiro valide os dados e depois gere o relatório.
text_b: Gere o relatório depois de validar os dados.

text_a: La reunión es el 07/08/2026.
text_b: La reunión es el 8 de julio de 2026.
what_differs: depends on whether the date is read as dd/mm (7 Aug) or mm/dd (July 8); no format given

text_a: First of all, fix the login bug; the UI polish can wait.
text_b: The login bug has priority over the UI polish.

text_a: Prepara los documentos en este orden: contrato, anexo y factura.
text_b: Prepara los documentos en este orden: contrato, factura y anexo.
what_differs: annex and invoice swapped in the sequence

text_a: Pode usar o carro desde que devolva antes das 18h.
text_b: Pode usar o carro e devolvê-lo antes das 18h.
what_differs: 'desde que' makes returning a condition for permission; the second reads as plain permission plus a task

text_a: Handle the urgent tickets first, then the rest.
text_b: Handle the tickets in priority order.
what_differs: two-tier ordering vs a full ranking; may or may not coincide depending on how many priority levels exist
